fonts.display: 'Hedvig Letters Serif', ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
fonts.body: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Deep Ink
palette.role: Primary text color, heading ink, card borders, secondary button fills — near-black violet that adds warmth over pure black

palette.name: Hi-Yellow
palette.role: Primary action fill (filled CTA buttons), hero pill backgrounds, accent highlights — bright highlighter yellow with near-black text for maximum contrast

palette.name: Moss Green
palette.role: Decorative organic shape fill behind hero — warm leaf green used in background blobs, not UI controls

palette.name: Fuchsia
palette.role: Decorative organic shape fill behind hero — vivid pink used in background blobs, not UI controls

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Body text, helper copy, muted icons, subtle borders — cool desaturated gray for secondary information

palette.name: Canvas
palette.role: Page background, button ghost fills, lightest surface — near-white with slight green-warmth

palette.name: Soft Meadow
palette.role: Card surfaces, nav background, elevated panels, hero backdrop — green-tinted off-white for soft surface separation

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Secondary dark button text and borders, nav dividers — softer than pure black for dark UI elements

palette.name: Onyx
palette.role: Logo mark, nav text, input borders, fine stroke details — true black for highest-contrast elements
